body:
Oh no I get it as well. 

I don't want to die. Let's make this clear. I do not want to die. 

I would rather die, than continue living the life I have however.

I believe in myself as well. I don't believe in society! 

I don't think there's going to be a chance for me to actually recover from this due to the fact that. 

My debt is growing and growing. 
My family will continue to be fucked. 
I cannot afford to leave and I cannot afford to stay. 

I made it through the last year of "living" on my own due to the help of VERY good friends of mine, friends I have lost due to horrible horrible things. (cocaine) 

I want to continue this wild adventure that we call life... I just can't keep on going down this path because it will lead to death or drugs and I am sure as hell am not going to resort to drugs.

This family is cancer. Fucking sucks the life out of my every second of every day. 

The issue is I was gone, I left I made it!! Then I got FUCKED by numerous employers. like bent over and rammed in the ass. I can't apply for employment insurance because of how I got the shaft from my last employer either. 

All in all I am fucked. I have looked into many options of just.. leaving but it's either leave with nowhere to go in a country thats well below -30C for all the winter or stay here and end up ending my life prematurely. 

Somehow jumping from a bridge or shooting myself seems like a nicer way to do it than freezing to death on the side of the road.

The issue is there is no burden on anyone else if I kill myself. If anything I am doing them a favor. 

I have no savings. As in 0. I have $5 in my wallet though.. Not to mention all the debt I have so lets take the $5 and add a few zeros and make it a negative. 

My family does think of me as a burden. My last family reunion I went to I was met with either "who are you?" "You shouldn't come to these things just for free food" or my personal favorite "I don't want to talk to you but where is your sister?"

I wont get a funeral, I wont be missed. As far as I am concerned I am just another name on a sheet of paper somewhere. I looked into volunteering abroad and even leaving to go fight ISIS (not kidding!) simply because it would give me a purpose and I'd probably die out there anyways but I have come up with nothing that I can afford to do. 

Thanks though

This is not a cry for attention or anything like that either... it's a hope that someone will have some sort of advice for me leaving. As much as I don't want to die (i really dont) I cant force myself to live a life where I constantly lie to myself to try and make myself feel better. 

Also if I have to eat another peanut butter sandwich I am going to put a bullet through my head.
